title: 第3126章 魔渊煞遁走重瞳之威第3125章 魔渊煞的疯狂吞噬
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
叶天与敖苍古的激战仍在继续，两人都注意到了那边的变故，但谁也无法分心。
他们的战斗已经到了白热化，每一次碰撞都引得混沌翻腾，本源哀鸣。
叶君与剑破虚的剑道对决愈发惊险，两人身上都开始出现细密的剑伤。
叶战与战不败依旧拳拳到肉。
魔渊煞重伤遁走，源始一击立威，血戮海与刹罗灭侥幸逃生。
这短暂的交锋却让整个大道源海的氛围再次剧变。
魔渊煞的疯狂吞噬给所有人敲响了警钟，在这个无法无天的狩猎场里，任何肆无忌惮的掠夺者都可能迅速成为所有人的公敌。
但同时，源始的“正义出手”背后，又何尝不是为了消除最危险的竞争者？
血戮海和刹罗灭退至战场边缘，两人身上魔气与血气缭绕，都在拼命炼化侵入体内的黑暗魔潮。
他们对视一眼，都看到了对方眼中的警惕与算计。
此刻的脆弱联盟瞬间瓦解——谁知道对方会不会在恢复后第一个对自己下手？
“血河族的，暂时罢手如何？”刹罗灭声音沙哑，战斧横在身前，保持着战斗姿态。
血戮海冷冷点头：“先疗伤。
但若你敢轻举妄动……”他身后的血河翻涌，无数血色魂影发出无声的咆哮。
两人各自拉开距离，却又不离开对方视线，形成了一种诡异的对峙。
而在战场中央，几处主战团却杀得越发惨烈。
仙临尘的斩缘仙剑越发诡异刁钻，每一剑都仿佛斩在叶昊大道根基的要害处，让他不得不耗费大量心神应对。
但重瞳至尊仙帝体的强大悟性，也在这极致压力下被彻底激发。
叶昊的重瞳之中，日月轮转的速度越来越快，瞳孔深处仿佛有无数仙道符文在生灭演化。
仙临尘每一次出剑，那斩断因果、破灭万法的轨迹，都被重瞳捕捉、解析、推演。

“原来如此……仙道不朽，并非真的万法不侵，而是以己身道基为根，以不朽本源为盾，将外界攻击‘排斥’或‘转化’……”叶昊心中明悟渐生。
就在仙临尘又一剑刺来，剑光缥缈如烟，直指叶昊与周围仙道本源的联系时，叶昊突然闭上了左眼。
右眼之中，那轮明月骤然爆发出前所未有的清冷光辉！
这光辉并非攻击，而是一种极致的“映照”——它将仙临尘这一剑的所有变化，所有因果牵连，所有道韵波动，全都清晰无比地“映照”出来，纤毫毕现！
同时，左眼虽然闭合，但至尊骨却爆发出璀璨金光，一道纯粹到极致的“至尊仙光”从叶昊眉心射出。
这道仙光不再追求变化与威势，而是凝聚成一根针。
一根以“至尊”意志为核心，以重瞳映照出的破绽为目标的“破法之针”！
嗤——！
针尖精准无比地点在了斩缘仙剑剑光最薄弱，与仙临尘本体联系最微妙的那一点上！
仙临尘脸色骤变！
content_en:
The fierce battle between Ye Tian and Ao Canggu continued. Both of them noticed the changes over there, but no one could be distracted.
Their battle has reached a fever pitch, with every collision causing chaos to churn and the source to wail.
The kendo duel between Ye Jun and Jian Poxu became increasingly thrilling, and fine sword wounds began to appear on both of them.
Ye Zhan and Zhan Bubai are still fighting hard.
Mo Yuan Sha was seriously injured and escaped, Yuan Shi established his power with one blow, and Xue Lu Hai and Sha Luo Mie had a lucky escape.
This brief confrontation caused the entire atmosphere of Daoyuanhai to change drastically again.
The crazy devouring of Mo Yuansha has sounded the alarm for everyone. In this lawless hunting ground, any unscrupulous plunderer may quickly become the public enemy of everyone.
But at the same time, behind Yuanshi's "just action", isn't it to eliminate the most dangerous competitor?
Xueluhai and Shalua Mie retreated to the edge of the battlefield, their bodies filled with demonic energy and blood energy, both of them desperately refining the dark demonic tide that invaded their bodies.
They looked at each other and saw the vigilance and calculation in each other's eyes.
The fragile alliance at this moment collapsed instantly - who knew whether the other party would be the first to attack him after recovering?
"Blood River Clan, how about we give up for now?" Sha Luo Mie's voice was hoarse, with his battle ax lying in front of him, maintaining a fighting posture.
Xueluhai nodded coldly: "Heal your wounds first.
But if you dare to act rashly..." The blood river behind him surged, and countless bloody souls roared silently.
The two of them distanced themselves but did not leave each other's sight, forming a strange confrontation.
But in the center of the battlefield, several main battle groups were killing each other more fiercely.
Xian Linchen's sword of slashing the edge became more and more weird and cunning. Each sword seemed to strike at a vital point at the foundation of Ye Hao's avenue, so he had to expend a lot of energy to deal with it.
But the powerful comprehension of the Supreme Immortal Emperor Body with Double Eyes was also completely stimulated under this extreme pressure.
In Ye Hao's double pupils, the sun and moon rotated faster and faster, and there seemed to be countless immortal runes in the depths of his pupils that were evolving and dying.
Every time Xian Linchen draws his sword, the trajectory of cutting off cause and effect and destroying all laws is captured, analyzed, and deduced by his heavy eyes.
"So that's it... Immortality in the Immortal Way is not really invulnerable to all laws, but it uses the foundation of one's own body as the root and the source of immortality as a shield to 'reject' or 'transform' external attacks..." Ye Hao gradually became enlightened.
Just when Xian Linchen stabbed with another sword, the light of the sword was as ethereal as smoke, pointing directly at Ye Hao's connection with the origin of the surrounding immortality, Ye Hao suddenly closed his left eye.
In his right eye, the bright moon suddenly burst out with an unprecedented cold brilliance!
This brilliance is not an attack, but an ultimate "reflection" - it will "reflect" all the changes in Xian Linchen's sword, all the causal connections, and all the fluctuations of the Tao rhyme with incomparable clarity, every detail!
At the same time, although the left eye was closed, the Supreme Bone burst out with bright golden light, and a pure and extremely pure "Supreme Immortal Light" shot out from the center of Ye Hao's eyebrows.
This fairy light no longer pursues change and power, but condenses into a needle.
A "law-breaking needle" with the "Supreme" will as its core and the flaw reflected in the double pupil as its target!
laugh--!
The tip of the needle was placed with incomparable precision at the point where the sword light of the Zhanyuan Immortal Sword was weakest and where the connection with Xian Linchen's body was most subtle!
Xian Linchen's expression suddenly changed!
